facts.fact: Egypt's finance minister said the Ministry of Finance's government e-payment and collection centre has taken government payments and collections over several electronic channels since May 2019.
Egypt's finance minister said electronic customs receipts were EGP 284.3 billion and electronic tax collection EGP 613.1 billion in July 2023 to May 2024.
Egypt's finance minister said services of electronic payment and collection totalled EGP 2.5 trillion in the first 11 months of FY2023/24, against EGP 2.1 trillion a year earlier.
